core_obligations: Field construction: for s in S choose preimages s_i in each T_i; a huge field extension K/kappa(s) embeds all kappa(s_i), giving morphisms Spec(K) -> T_i over S.
Compatibility: the morphisms Spec(K) -> T_i agree as morphisms to S, hence define a morphism Spec(K) -> T into the product; its image maps to s.
proof_roadmap: Common field extension embeds all residue fields.
Compatible family gives a point of the product over s.
difficulty_reason: Huge field extension construction: embed all residue fields kappa(s_i) into one K over kappa(s), build compatible morphisms Spec(K) -> T_i, obtain a point of the product over s. Complete in span.
